bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, capped at the 100-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转多，受制于 100 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 1.3% on Nov 10 to $515.21, trading $495.00–539.25 on heavy volume (1.59x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($473.2), 10-day ($496.6) and 200-day ($418.5) and below the 30-day ($552.9) and 100-day ($526.6); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 10 ($402.10), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: AMD 11月10日上涨 1.3%，收于 $515.21，盘中区间 $495.00–539.25，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.59 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$473.2）、10 日（$496.6）和 200 日（$418.5）均线上方，30 日（$552.9）和 100 日（$526.6）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月10日转为看多（$402.10），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close edged above the $514.6–515.2 Nov 4 and Nov 9 highs, but the $539.25 high faded back under the 100-day ($526.6). Resistance is $520.4–526.6 (Oct 30 high, 100-day), then $539.3 (Nov 10 high) and $552.9 (30-day). Support is $495–503 (Nov 10 low, 10-day, Oct 22 low), then $466–476 and $433–440.5. A close above $526.6 would target $539–553; below $495, $466–476.
